svg.aria-label: Sketch: a tank trailer parked at night under the lit canopy of a fuel station, drawn after an NBC News photograph illustrating the G7 oil and diesel release. A white tractor cab at left pulls a long cylindrical tank on a framed chassis, its rear wheels under the canopy's steel columns; a fuel dispenser and a trash bin stand on the island in the foreground, and a second lit canopy and store sit in the distance at right under a dark hatched sky. No people in the scene.
